steps.name: ServerConfig::from_env() + real main.rs
steps.implementation_notes: Create crates/embyr-server/src/config.rs with ServerConfig struct and from_env(). Replace main.rs stub with real tokio::main calling ServerConfig::from_env() → SystemDb::new() → migrate() → alloc_test_components() wired with real config → spawn_all_servers() → signal wait. Use existing lib.rs functions. Add GET /healthz route on admin_router returning 200 OK.

steps.name: Exit 1 on missing/invalid env vars
steps.implementation_notes: ServerConfig::from_env() must return Err with descriptive message for each missing required var. main() must print to stderr and exit with code 1. EMBYR_ENCRYPTION_KEY validation: must be exactly 64 hex chars, decoded to [u8;32].

steps.name: Exit 1 on DB unreachable / probe failure
steps.implementation_notes: After ServerConfig::from_env() succeeds, main() calls SystemDb::new(db_url).await. On error: stderr + exit 1. After SystemDb constructed, calls systemdb.migrate().await. On error: stderr + exit 1. SystemDb probe should verify connectivity.

steps.name: Non-default ports + healthz
steps.implementation_notes: main.rs must read GRPC_PORT, REST_PORT, ADMIN_PORT from ServerConfig and pass to spawn_all_servers. GET /healthz on admin router must respond 200.

steps.name: SIGTERM graceful drain
steps.implementation_notes: main.rs spawns spawn_all_servers then waits on tokio::signal::ctrl_c() OR SIGTERM (unix signal). On signal: send shutdown to servers, drain, exit 0. Use tokio::signal::unix::{signal, SignalKind} for SIGTERM on Linux/macOS.

steps.name: In-flight request completes before shutdown
steps.criteria: in_flight_request_completes_before_shutdown passes: a slow gRPC request issued before SIGTERM must still receive its response after SIGTERM is sent, and the server must exit 0 only after that response is delivered
steps.implementation_notes: Test currently has a todo!() stub. Implement: start server, open a long-lived gRPC call (e.g. Listen stream, or a handler with an injected delay reachable via existing test scaffolding), send SIGTERM while the call is in flight, assert the client still receives a valid response/frame after SIGTERM, then assert the process exits 0 within the drain timeout. Production code: verify spawn_all_servers' shutdown wiring actually waits for in-flight tonic handlers to complete (tonic's built-in graceful shutdown via axum::serve/Server::serve with a shutdown future) rather than aborting connections immediately. May require no production code changes if graceful drain already works — in that case this step is pure test authoring plus verification.

steps.name: Multi-stage Dockerfile
steps.criteria: docker_build_succeeds, docker_image_runs_as_non_root, docker_image_under_100mb pass (when Docker available)
steps.implementation_notes: Create Dockerfile at repo root. 4-stage: chef (cargo-chef install) → planner (cargo chef prepare) → builder (cargo chef cook + cargo build --release --bin embyr-server) → runtime (debian:bookworm-slim, useradd embyr, non-root, EXPOSE 8080 8081 9090, ENTRYPOINT). No COPY migrations/ needed — sqlx::migrate!() embeds at compile time. Add .dockerignore to exclude target/, .git/, docs/.

steps.name: GitHub Actions CI
steps.implementation_notes: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml. Jobs: test (ubuntu-latest, postgres:15 service, cargo test --workspace), lint (cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings + cargo deny check), docker (depends on test, docker build). Triggers: push to master, pull_request targeting master. Use dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable, Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.

steps.name: DES integrity verification
steps.implementation_notes: Run cargo test --test production_readiness (walking skeleton must pass). Run des-verify-integrity. Fix any violations.
